phase: 9B.1 — real accounts, cloud career, My EraClash

results.name: Google and an email one-time code are the two routes to an account
the flow is PKCE with a persisted, auto-refreshed session
no password field exists anywhere in the product
the callback route exchanges the code itself rather than trusting a URL fragment
the address bar is scrubbed BEFORE the exchange, so no code survives in history
the return destination is filtered through the same-origin guard
the dialog is a real modal: labelled, focus-trapped and dismissible by Escape
failures are a closed vocabulary, and the provider's own text never reaches the UI
sign-out clears the account from memory immediately and keeps guest play
an active Chaos run and the current result are not touched by the callback
the header offers Sign in beside Create free account when accounts are real
a wrong code is refused and the right code signs the right user in

flows.signOut: provider session ended, state cleared, guest play intact
